question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Induction
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Induction"** means the action or process of formally admitting someone to a position or organization. (प्रवेश)

 
 
• **Example: **The **induction** ceremony for the new employees was held in the conference hall.
 
 
 
• **"Inauguration"** refers to the formal admission or introduction of someone to a new position or office. (उद्घाटन)
 
 
• **Example: **The **inauguration **of the new president took place at the capital city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Induction'** is **'Inauguration'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Capital** (राजधानी): The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative centre of a country or region.

 
 
• **Example:** New Delhi is the capital of India.
 
 
 
• **References** (संदर्भ): The act of mentioning something in speech or writing.
 
 
• **Example:** The report included references to various historical events.
 
 
 
• **Expulsion** (निष्कासन): The action of depriving someone of membership in an organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The student faced expulsion for cheating in the examination.
